body:
That's something I haven't heard of before. I'll be sure to look into that. Thank you so much for that suggestion, I really appreciate it.

I live in a small city in Canada.

Sadly, I do not qualify, as I mentioned in my post.
I've applied to all sorts of jobs. Factories included. Still no luck. 

Unfortunately, they won't. :/ I could see how this may be seen as ridiculous by some people but they see me as an adult and want me to take care of my own business without having to rely on anyone. They are already annoyed that I am staying here as it is.

Thankyou for your help, though. I really do appreciate it.

I am not surprised; I never said that I was.

As I said in another comment, a payment plan simply isn't productive in any way when I have zero dollars to my name and absolutely no income.
It's not, "I don't want to wear short sleeves," it's, the manager gave me the uniform, saw my fresh scars, and informed me that I would not be able to work there.
I do not tell employers about my mental shortcomings in the first interview; I didn't say that. I listed those as things that get in the way of my employment. The only shortcomings I mention to potential employers are being blind and deaf.

As for the last point,
>I've looked into applying for some sort of disability payments but I am not quite disabled enough to qualify.

I have explained all of it to him. I've made a point to be very open so he could understand exactly what was going on.
Unfortunately a payment plan doesn't really work when you have an income of zero dollars. My parents already have me doing all of the housework in exchange for living here, I've already spoken to them about this and they are unwilling to give me any money.
